hooks.description: Prints the house rules and the latest session notes for this project into Claude's context.
Blocks git commit/push --no-verify, git commit -n and core.hooksPath overrides.
Blocks Shopify CLI commands that change the live store (live theme push, theme publish/delete, app deploy/release) until the user approves.
Blocks writing Shopify tokens, live payment keys, cloud keys or private keys into files other than .env.
Strict profile only: runs Theme Check, ESLint or Ruff on the edited file and reports problems.
Saves a short session summary before the conversation is compacted.
Saves a short session summary when the session ends.
